import base64,hashlib,itertools,json,pathlib,zlib
from fractions import Fraction as F
R=pathlib.Path.cwd(); scale=1<<149
def digest(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def q(pair):return F(*pair)
def decode(w):
    assert type(w) is int and 0<=w<1<<32
    e=(w>>23)&255; m=w&((1<<23)-1)
    assert e!=255 and (e!=0 or m==0)
    if e==0:return F(0)
    return (-1 if w>>31 else 1)*F((1<<23)+m)*F(2)**(e-150)
def coord(words):
    assert len(words)==2
    return sum(map(decode,words),F(0))
def signed(words):
    assert len(words)==16 and all(type(w) is int and 0<=w<1<<32 for w in words)
    n=sum(w<<(32*i) for i,w in enumerate(words))
    return n-(1<<512) if n>>511 else n
def raw(run):
    b=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(run['stdout_zlib_base64']))
    assert len(b)==run['stdout_bytes'] and digest(b)==run['stdout_sha256']
    return json.loads(b)
def validate(report):
    for name,sha in report['code_doc_sha256'].items():assert digest((R/name).read_bytes())==sha,name
    previous=report['previous_report']
    oldbytes=(R/previous['path']).read_bytes();assert digest(oldbytes)==previous['sha256']
    old=json.loads(oldbytes); assert len(old['code_doc_sha256'])==89
    for name,sha in old['code_doc_sha256'].items():assert report['code_doc_sha256'][name]==sha
    failed=report['initial_child_failures'][0]; assert failed['rc']==1 and 'errors=8' in failed['stderr']
    assert 'canonical nonnegative rational bound required' in failed['stderr']
    assert raw(failed)['cases']=={}
    assert failed['code_doc_sha256_at_run']['Blender/benchmarks/capacity_audit/axial_geometry_words_cpu_v1.py']!=report['code_doc_sha256']['Blender/benchmarks/capacity_audit/axial_geometry_words_cpu_v1.py']
    run=report['test_run']; assert run['rc']==0 and 'Ran 8 tests' in run['stderr'] and 'OK' in run['stderr']
    data=raw(run); assert data['CPU_only'] and len(data['cases'])==13
    flags=('GPU_executed','ALU_executed','native_geometry_implemented','execution_authenticated','accepted_full_field_pipeline','field_values_computed','native_promotion_allowed')
    count={'cases':13,'sources':0,'integer_nodes':0,'geometry_accepted_sources':0,'phase_accepted_sources':0,'geometry_corners':0,'phase_corners':0,'phase_original_oracles':0,'rejected_sources':0,'frozen_pins':90,'code_doc_fingerprints':len(report['code_doc_sha256'])}
    for name,e in data['cases'].items():
        assert all(e[f] is False for f in flags)
        b=e['word_ABI']; scene=e['scene_snapshot']
        assert 'hits' not in b and 'length' not in b
        assert e['geometry_model']==b['model']==report['model']
        assert digest(json.dumps(b,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode())==e['word_ABI_sha256']
        ids=b['object_ids']; order=b['source_order']
        assert order==[s['id'] for s in scene['sources']]==[s['source_id'] for s in b['sources']]
        assert set(ids)==set(scene['objects']) and len(ids)==len(set(ids))
        binding={'snapshot':scene,'object_order':ids,'source_order':order}
        assert digest(json.dumps(binding,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode())==b['original_scene_binding_sha256']
        assert e['pins_verified']==dict(old['code_doc_sha256'],**{previous['path']:previous['sha256']})
        extra=q(b['extra_radius_HOST_BU_rational']);outward=q(b['extra_radius_HOST_outward_inflation_BU_rational'])
        assert extra>=0 and outward>=0 and (extra+outward)*scale==int((extra+outward)*scale)
        planes={}; triangles=[];origplanes={};pid=0
        for oi,oid in enumerate(ids):
            obj=scene['objects'][oid]
            assert b['kinds'][oi]==obj['kind']
            if obj['kind']=='mirror':assert F(obj['phase_rad'])==0
            for face in obj['faces']:
                t=b['triangles'][pid];assert t['owner']==oi
                original=[obj['vertices_world_BU'][i] for i in face]
                xyz=[[coord(w) for w in v] for v in t['vertices_uint32_hilo']]
                assert len(xyz)==3 and all(len(v)==3 for v in xyz)
                assert len({v[0] for v in original})==1 and len({v[0] for v in xyz})==1
                for a,d in zip(original,xyz):
                    assert [F(x) for x in a[1:]]==d[1:]
                radius=F(t['X_radius_scaled'],scale);assert type(t['X_radius_scaled']) is int and radius>=extra
                needed=max(abs(F(a[0])-d[0]) for a,d in zip(original,xyz))
                ce=needed*scale;ceil=(ce.numerator+ce.denominator-1)//ce.denominator
                assert radius==F(ceil,scale)+extra+outward
                plane=(xyz[0][0],xyz[0][0]-radius,xyz[0][0]+radius)
                assert all(plane[1]<=F(a[0])<=plane[2] for a in original)
                if oi in planes:assert planes[oi]==plane and origplanes[oi]==F(original[0][0])
                planes[oi]=plane;origplanes[oi]=F(original[0][0])
                triangles.append((pid,oi,xyz));pid+=1
        assert pid==len(b['triangles'])
        lam=coord(b['wavelength_uint32_hilo']);lr=F(b['wavelength_radius_scaled'],scale)
        assert lr>=0 and lam-lr>0 and lam-lr<=F(scene['lambda_BU'])<=lam+lr
        needed=abs(F(scene['lambda_BU'])-lam)*scale
        assert b['wavelength_radius_scaled']==(needed.numerator+needed.denominator-1)//needed.denominator
        assert len(e['operations'])==e['integer_operations']
        for node in e['operations']:
            a,c=map(signed,node['input_words_signed512']);v=signed(node['output_words_signed512'])
            assert node['op'] in ('add','sub','mul')
            expected=a+c if node['op']=='add' else (a-c if node['op']=='sub' else a*c)
            assert -(1<<511)<=expected<(1<<511) and v==expected
            count['integer_nodes']+=1
        for src,orig,row in zip(b['sources'],scene['sources'],e['sources']):
            count['sources']+=1;assert row['source_id']==src['source_id']==orig['id']
            origin=list(map(coord,src['origin_uint32_hilo']));direction=list(map(coord,src['direction_uint32_hilo']))
            assert origin[1:]==list(map(F,orig['position_BU'][1:]))
            assert direction==list(map(F,orig['direction'])) and direction in ([1,0,0],[-1,0,0])
            sign=int(direction[0]);sr=F(src['X_radius_scaled'],scale)
            needed=abs(F(orig['position_BU'][0])-origin[0])*scale
            assert sr==F((needed.numerator+needed.denominator-1)//needed.denominator,scale)+extra+outward
            assert origin[0]-sr<=F(orig['position_BU'][0])<=origin[0]+sr
            def inside():
                hits=[]
                for pi,owner,xyz in triangles:
                    a,c,d=xyz; by,bz=c[1]-a[1],c[2]-a[2];cy,cz=d[1]-a[1],d[2]-a[2];py,pz=origin[1]-a[1],origin[2]-a[2]
                    det=by*cz-bz*cy;assert det!=0
                    u=(py*cz-pz*cy)/det;v=(by*pz-bz*py)/det;w=1-u-v
                    if min(u,v,w)<0:continue
                    if min(u,v,w)==0:raise ValueError('boundary hit excluded; no snap')
                    hits.append((pi,owner))
                return hits
            def select(hits,lo,hi,direction,departure=None):
                cand=[];skipped=[];behind=[]
                for pi,owner in hits:
                    if owner==departure:skipped.append(pi);continue
                    _,a,c=planes[owner]
                    low,high=(a-hi,c-lo) if direction>0 else (lo-c,hi-a)
                    if high<0:behind.append(pi);continue
                    if low<=0:raise ValueError('other owner zero contact' if departure is not None else 'source zero contact')
                    cand.append((pi,owner,low,high))
                if not cand:raise ValueError('no strictly positive root')
                pi,owner,low,high=min(cand,key=lambda x:x[2])
                gaps=[(planes[o][1]-planes[owner][2]) if direction>0 else (planes[owner][1]-planes[o][2]) for p,o,_,_ in cand if p!=pi]
                if gaps and min(gaps)<=0:raise ValueError('competitor intervals overlap/touch')
                return pi,owner,low,high,skipped,behind,min(gaps) if gaps else None
            try:
                hits=inside();first=select(hits,origin[0]-sr,origin[0]+sr,sign);mi=first[1]
                if b['kinds'][mi]!='mirror':raise ValueError('first event must be mirror')
                second=select(hits,planes[mi][1],planes[mi][2],-sign,mi);di=second[1]
                if b['kinds'][di] not in ('det','escape'):raise ValueError('second event must be terminal')
            except ValueError as err:
                assert not row['accepted_geometry_words_CPU_only'] and not row['accepted_phase_budget_CPU_only']
                assert row['reason']==str(err),(name,str(err),row['reason'])
                count['rejected_sources']+=1;continue
            assert row['accepted_geometry_words_CPU_only'];count['geometry_accepted_sources']+=1
            for seg,s in zip(row['segments'],(first,second)):
                pi,owner,lo,hi,skipped,behind,gap=s
                assert seg['primitive_id']==pi and seg['owner']==owner
                assert seg['segment_interval_scaled']==[int(lo*scale),int(hi*scale)]
                assert seg['same_owner_departures_skipped']==skipped and seg['behind']==behind
                assert seg['competitor_clearance_scaled']==(None if gap is None else int(gap*scale))
            lo=2*planes[mi][1]-(origin[0]+sr)-planes[di][2]
            hi=2*planes[mi][2]-(origin[0]-sr)-planes[di][1]
            if sign<0:lo,hi=-hi,-lo
            assert row['length_interval_scaled']==[int(lo*scale),int(hi*scale)]
            assert [q(x) for x in row['length_interval_BU_rational']]==[lo,hi]
            original=sign*(2*origplanes[mi]-F(orig['position_BU'][0])-origplanes[di])
            assert lo<=original<=hi and q(row['original_length_BU_rational'])==original
            cycles=original/F(scene['lambda_BU'])
            phase=8*max(abs(lo/(lam+lr)-cycles),abs(hi/(lam-lr)-cycles))
            assert q(row['phase_error_bound_rad'])==phase
            assert row['accepted_phase_budget_CPU_only']==(phase<=q(row['phase_budget_rad']))
            assert row['phase_reference_id']=='original-source-zero:'+b['original_scene_binding_sha256']+':'+orig['id']
            count['phase_original_oracles']+=1;count['phase_accepted_sources']+=int(row['accepted_phase_budget_CPU_only'])
            for sx,mx,dx in itertools.product((origin[0]-sr,origin[0]+sr),planes[mi][1:],planes[di][1:]):
                positions={mi:mx,di:dx}
                def corner(x,direction,departure=None):
                    candidates=[(direction*(positions[o]-x),pi,o) for pi,o in hits if o!=departure and direction*(positions[o]-x)>0]
                    dist,pi,o=min(candidates);return dist,pi,o
                length,p1,o1=corner(sx,sign);tail,p2,o2=corner(mx,-sign,mi)
                assert (p1,o1,p2,o2)==(first[0],mi,second[0],di)
                assert length+tail==sign*(2*mx-sx-dx) and lo<=length+tail<=hi
                count['geometry_corners']+=1
                for wavelength in (lam-lr,lam+lr):
                    assert 8*abs((length+tail)/wavelength-cycles)<=phase
                    count['phase_corners']+=1
        assert e['accepted_geometry_words_CPU_only']==all(r['accepted_geometry_words_CPU_only'] for r in e['sources'])
        assert e['accepted_phase_budget_CPU_only']==all(r['accepted_phase_budget_CPU_only'] for r in e['sources'])
    assert data['cases']['nonexact_geometry_phase_FAIL']['accepted_geometry_words_CPU_only']
    assert not data['cases']['nonexact_geometry_phase_FAIL']['accepted_phase_budget_CPU_only']
    assert not data['cases']['thin_collapsed_FAIL']['accepted_geometry_words_CPU_only']
    assert count['sources']==14 and count['rejected_sources']==5
    assert len(report['code_doc_sha256'])==93
    if report.get('independent_validation',{}).get('result'):assert count==report['independent_validation']['result']
    return count
